shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A mechanical plunger. The whole skill shot is getting each new ball to run through the Door rather than dropping short into the B-O-P lanes.

shots.name: The Door
shots.notes: The entry immediately right of the B-O-P lanes. Plunging through it pays the Door Prize, which climbs every time you manage it.

shots.name: B-O-P Lanes
shots.notes: Three rollovers across the top centre. Lighting all three adds 2x to the bonus multiplier and arms the Dance Contest.

shots.name: The Boppers
shots.notes: Three jet bumpers in a Y under the B-O-P lanes. Ordinarily background noise — but Millions Per Bop turns each one into a million, and with 10x playfield running, ten.

shots.name: Back-2-Bop Lane
shots.notes: Right of the ramp, feeding back up to the B-O-P lanes. It starts the Dance Contest when lit and pays its own climbing award when not. Be aware that a ball falling back down here can head straight for the gap between the flippers.

shots.name: Rocket Ramp
shots.notes: The ramp with the rocket perched on it, and the busiest shot on the machine. It pays the Ozone Bonus, collects EAT, awards the extra ball, and during multiball it is where rocket fuel is cashed and the Big Bang is collected.

shots.name: Advance End Zone Bonus Target
shots.notes: A target at the base of the ramp that is only worth hitting while it is lit — and the right inlane is what lights it.

shots.name: Captain Bizarre Saucer
shots.notes: The saucer in the middle of the playfield. It is where requests are made, where BE MERRY is collected, and after your first multiball it is the shot that relights the Cottage passes.

shots.name: Request Targets
shots.notes: Two yellow targets flanking the Captain Bizarre saucer. Both must be lit before the saucer will give you a request.

shots.name: Cosmic Cottage
shots.notes: The purple hut at the top right, with its entry lane beneath. Passing through it with a party pass flashing is the route to Happy Hour.

shots.name: Comic Entry
shots.notes: The entry just left of the Cosmic Cottage. This is the approach that matters when DRINK is counting down.

shots.name: Comic Saucer
shots.notes: The saucer under the robot comic's head, top right. It starts lit at the beginning of every ball, and what it pays depends entirely on whether DRINK and the Comic are lit.

shots.name: Ha-Ha-Ha Targets
shots.notes: Three targets below the comic saucer. Completing them brings the comic back for about ten seconds, and they sit conveniently on the way to the saucer.

shots.name: E-D-B-M Targets
shots.notes: Five green targets down the left side. Clearing them lights EAT and starts the Eat, Drink and Be Merry chain.

shots.name: Way Out Of Control Targets
shots.notes: Four targets on the right. Clearing them lights one of four awards — but once an award is waiting, further hits here do nothing until you have collected it.

shots.name: Payoff Lane
shots.notes: The lane behind the Way Out Of Control targets, and the single most important shot for scoring. It collects whatever award is lit, and pays a climbing million when nothing is.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: The natural return that sets up the ramp and the left side of the playfield.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Rolling through here lights the Advance End Zone Bonus target at the base of the ramp.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Where the End Zone Bonus is actually paid out — a drain down either outlane cashes whatever you have built.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The same End Zone Bonus payout on this side.

goals.title: Door Prize Skill Plunge
goals.summary: Plunge each new ball through the Door rather than letting it drop into the lanes. It pays a million the first time and another million every time after, up to at least ten — which makes it the cheapest big scoring habit on the machine.

steps.action: Plunge slightly past a lane-filling shot
steps.detail: The Door sits just right of the B-O-P lanes, so aim a touch stronger than a plunge that would merely fill the lanes. Do it on every ball — it is the fastest way to have millions on the board before you have made a single real shot.

goals.title: End Zone Bonus
goals.summary: A quiet accumulator with a two-step setup. The right inlane lights the target at the base of the ramp; hitting it while lit adds 100,000. You are paid the total when the ball drains down either outlane.
goals.reward: 100,000 per lit hit, paid on the drain

steps.detail: Nothing else lights it, so the sequence always starts with a right inlane return.
An unlit hit is worth nothing, so check before you commit.

goals.title: Request Time
goals.summary: Light both Request targets, then put the ball in the Captain Bizarre saucer. It pays 250,000 and hands you the music selection — and more usefully, it is how you get a party pass out of the Captain.

steps.detail: They sit either side of the saucer, so a sloppy shot at the saucer often lights one on the way in.
This is also what the bouncer at the Cosmic Cottage tells you to do when you turn up without a pass.

goals.title: Party Saver
goals.summary: Leave the Captain alone too long and he starts playing his own favourites. Make a request while he is doing that and you collect the Party Saver — five million, and five million more every time you catch it again.
instructions: It only becomes available after a long stretch of play with no request made, so it rewards ignoring the saucer rather than working it.
The cue is the music changing to something the Captain clearly picked himself. There is no playfield light for it.
Have both Request targets already lit before that happens, or you will spend the window setting up instead of collecting.
In theory it can be collected with 10x playfield running, which would be enormous, but it takes real planning to line up.
Some ROM revisions do not have this feature working at all, so if you never see it on a particular machine, that may be why.

goals.title: Light B-O-P
goals.summary: Complete the three top lanes and you get 2x added to your bonus multiplier, which tops out at 8x. The same completion also arms the Dance Contest at the Back-2-Bop lane.
goals.reward: +2x bonus multiplier, up to 8x, and the Dance Contest armed

steps.detail: The boppers underneath will keep kicking the ball back up through them, so this often finishes itself.

steps.action: Cash it as a Dance Contest
steps.detail: With B-O-P complete, the Back-2-Bop lane starts the contest rather than paying its own award.

goals.title: Dance Contest
goals.summary: A bumper frenzy with no fixed timer. Every bopper hit adds a climbing amount to the dance total, and the mode only ends when the boppers have gone about ten seconds untouched — so keeping the ball anywhere near them is the entire skill.

steps.detail: The dancer on the playfield tells you it is live.
The lane feeds straight back up into the lanes above the boppers, which is exactly where you want to be.
Every hit adds more than the last. Ten quiet seconds and it is over.

goals.title: Back-2-Bop Award
goals.summary: When the Dance Contest is not armed, the Back-2-Bop lane pays its own climbing award instead — 50,000 to start and 50,000 more each time. It is a good habit shot because it always feeds you back into the top of the playfield.

steps.detail: It returns you to the B-O-P lanes, which builds the bonus multiplier at the same time.
A ball dropping back out of the boppers down this lane can head straight down the middle, so be ready to nudge.

goals.title: Eat, Drink And Be Merry
goals.summary: A three-shot chain on a rolling clock. Clear the green targets to light EAT, then each collect lights the next stage for about ten seconds. Done cleanly it is a million, then two, then three.
goals.reward: 1 million, 2 million and 3 million in sequence

steps.detail: This lights EAT at the base of the ramp.

steps.action: EAT on the ramp for 1 million
steps.detail: The collect lights DRINK for roughly ten seconds.

steps.action: DRINK at the comic saucer for 2 million
steps.detail: Go in through the comic entry. Lighting BE MERRY starts another ten-second window.

steps.action: BE MERRY at the Captain for 3 million
steps.detail: The saucer in the middle of the playfield closes the chain.

goals.title: Way Out Of Control
goals.summary: Clear the four right-side targets and one of four awards lights. Only one can be waiting at a time, so once something is lit, stop shooting these targets and go collect — every further hit is wasted effort.
goals.reward: 5 million, Millions Per Bop, 10x playfield, or a Special

steps.detail: The four awards are five million, Millions Per Bop, 10x playfield for about ten seconds, and a Special.
The award waits there indefinitely — except the Special, which gets swapped for one of the other three if you drain before collecting it.
Once you have cycled through all four awards, or collected a Big Bang, each award only stays available for about ten seconds.

goals.title: The Payoff Lane
goals.summary: With nothing lit, the Payoff lane pays a million and climbs a million each time — reportedly to ten, which is the highest repeatable award on the machine. Learning this shot is the single biggest thing you can do for your score.
goals.reward: 1 million, climbing to around 10 million a shot

steps.detail: Every clean pass raises the value by a million, so the early cheap shots are an investment.
A lit Way Out Of Control award takes priority over the climbing value, so collect it and get back to grinding.

goals.title: Ozone Bonus And The Extra Balls
goals.summary: The ramp pays an Ozone Bonus that opens at 100,000 and rises by 100,000, capping at 2 million on most machines. More importantly, ramp shots stack toward extra balls on a ladder that gets longer each time.
goals.reward: Ozone Bonus up to 2 million, plus repeatable extra balls

steps.detail: Each shot raises the Ozone Bonus by 100,000. A few machines run the cap up at 5 million instead.
The first extra ball takes six ramps, then eight, then eleven, then fourteen, then eighteen — the last shot of each set is the one that collects it.
With EAT lit the same ramp shot pays a million instead of the ordinary Ozone Bonus.

goals.title: Relight The Comic
goals.summary: The comic starts every ball lit and goes dark once you use him. The three Ha-Ha-Ha targets bring him back for about ten seconds, and they sit directly on the path to his saucer — so the relight and the collect are almost the same shot.
goals.reward: About ten seconds of a lit Comic

steps.detail: The game announces him coming back on, which is your cue that the clock has started.
Ten seconds is not long, but the targets are on the way there anyway.

goals.title: Comic Saucer Awards
goals.summary: What this saucer pays depends on two lights, and the difference is dramatic. With DRINK running it is worth millions; with the Comic lit and no DRINK it can hand you a multiball; with neither it is worth almost nothing.
goals.reward: Anything from 10,000 to a surprise multiball

steps.detail: Two million, and if the Comic is lit as well you also collect the Comic Award, somewhere between 100,000 and 900,000.

steps.action: With the Comic lit and no DRINK
steps.detail: One of three things: 2x added to the bonus multiplier, a Laff Attack, or a surprise two-ball multiball.
A climbing award that starts at just 10,000 — the clearest signal on the machine that you should relight him first.

goals.title: Laff Attack
goals.summary: A twenty-second frenzy where every target on the playfield is worth 100,000. There is nothing to aim at, so the right play is to stop aiming — keep the ball live and let it hit things.

steps.action: Draw it from the lit Comic
steps.detail: It is one of the three awards a lit Comic hands out when DRINK is not running.

steps.action: Get into the busy half of the playfield
steps.detail: The boppers and the target banks generate the most switch hits per second.

goals.title: Cosmic Cottage Party Passes
goals.summary: Three passes, collected in order, each worth 250,000 — and the third one is what opens Happy Hour. Each collect needs a pass flashing, a run through the Cottage, and then the comic saucer.
goals.reward: 250,000 each, and Happy Hour on the third

steps.action: Get a pass from the Captain
steps.detail: Turn up at the Cottage without one and the bouncer sends you away and tells you to make a request first.
The pass has to be flashing when you go through.
Party Animals, then Party Monsters, then Party Dudez — and Dudez brings the two-ball multiball with it.

goals.title: Happy Hour
goals.summary: A two-ball multiball built around rocket fuel. It opens with five million of fuel, or only one million if you have already collected a Big Bang. Fuel is built on the comic saucer and Back-2-Bop, and cashed on the ramp.
goals.reward: 1 to 7 million per ramp, then the Big Bang

steps.action: Start it with the third party pass
steps.detail: One ball sits in the comic saucer at the start, the other waits in the plunger lane, and the saucer will not let go of its ball until the plunged one has scored something.
The comic saucer and the Back-2-Bop lane each add a million of rocket fuel.
The ramp pays whatever the current fuel value is, between one and seven million.
With enough fuel banked, the next ramp pays ten million and locks the first ball, leaving you to send the second one up the ramp for the Big Bang itself.

Draining to one ball lights 2x playfield for the rest of that ball. After the first Happy Hour, Request Time is already lit, so the Captain's saucer alone relights the Cottage passes — but after the second, you have to relight it yourself.

goals.title: The Big Bang
goals.summary: The biggest single award on the machine, worth anywhere from ten million to just under a hundred million depending on how long it has been since the last one. Collecting it also drops the playfield into a frenzy that lasts until you lose a ball.

steps.action: Send the second ball up the ramp
steps.detail: Once the first ball is locked, the Big Bang is a single ramp shot away.
Every target is worth 250,000 until you drain. Note that 10x playfield does not multiply the Big Bang itself, so save it for the frenzy.
If you lose a ball with the Big Bang still uncollected, the leftover rocket fuel can still be cashed on the ramp, though it counts itself down a million at a time while you dither.

goals.title: The 10x Payoff Loop
goals.summary: The known high-score route on this machine, and it is a loop rather than a mode. Max out the Payoff lane first, then light 10x playfield off Way Out Of Control and cash that fully-built lane while the multiplier is live, for a hundred million.
goals.reward: Up to 100 million per Payoff lane shot

steps.action: Grind the lane to its maximum first
steps.detail: Do this before you light anything — the multiplier is only worth as much as the shot you are multiplying.
Ten seconds of everything doubled tenfold, with the Big Bang the only exception.

steps.action: Stack Millions Per Bop if you have it
steps.detail: Millions Per Bop lasts the whole ball, so having it running when 10x arrives makes each bopper worth ten million.

The ball usually settles on the left flipper afterwards, which is exactly the angle for another Payoff lane shot. A warning short of a tilt reportedly pauses the 10x timer, though it restarts the moment the ball touches anything.

achievements.title: Through The Door
achievements.desc: Skill plunge a ball through the Door for the Door Prize.

achievements.title: Make A Request
achievements.desc: Light both Request targets and take the Captain Bizarre saucer.

achievements.title: Dance Contest
achievements.desc: Complete B-O-P and start the Dance Contest at Back-2-Bop.

achievements.title: Eat, Drink And Be Merry
achievements.desc: Run the full chain from the green targets through to the Captain's saucer.

achievements.title: Way Out Of Control
achievements.desc: Clear the right-side bank and collect an award at the Payoff lane.

achievements.title: Six Ramps
achievements.desc: Collect an extra ball off the rocket ramp ladder.

achievements.title: Happy Hour
achievements.desc: Collect all three party passes and start the two-ball multiball.

achievements.title: Party Saver
achievements.desc: Catch the Captain playing his own favourites and make a request.

achievements.title: The Big Bang
achievements.desc: Lock a ball and send the second one up the ramp for the Big Bang.

achievements.title: Hundred Million Payoff
achievements.desc: Cash a maxed Payoff lane with 10x playfield running.

drills.title: Through The Door, Every Ball
drills.text: Plunge a touch harder than a shot that would merely fill the B-O-P lanes so the ball runs through the Door instead. It pays a million and another million every time after, which makes it the cheapest scoring habit here — groove it on every ball rather than treating it as a bonus.

drills.title: Grind The Payoff Lane
drills.text: With nothing lit, every clean pass through the Payoff lane raises its own value by a million, so the cheap early shots are the investment. If a Way Out Of Control award is waiting there it takes priority over the climbing value — collect it and get straight back to the grind.
drills.reps: one full ball, counting clean passes

drills.title: Run The Whole Chain
drills.text: Clear the five green targets to light EAT, then run it on the rolling clock: EAT on the rocket ramp, DRINK at the comic saucer through the comic entry, BE MERRY at the Captain. Each collect only buys about ten seconds, so take the next shot off the return instead of settling the ball.

drills.title: Ramp In Sets Of Six
drills.text: The rocket ramp is the busiest shot on the machine and every shot counts twice — it raises the Ozone Bonus and it steps the extra ball ladder, with the first one landing on the sixth ramp. Shoot it in sets of six, and take it with EAT lit where you can, because the same shot pays a million instead of the ordinary bonus.

drills.title: Know Where Back-2-Bop Comes Back
drills.text: The lane pays a climbing award and feeds you back up into the top lanes, so it is a habit shot worth having — but a ball dropping back out of the boppers down this side runs straight at the gap between the flippers. Shoot it knowing that, and have the nudge ready instead of reaching for a flipper you cannot get to.

drills.title: Relight Him, Then Take Him
drills.text: An unlit comic saucer pays a climbing award starting at ten thousand, which is the machine telling you to relight him first. The three Ha-Ha-Ha targets sit directly on the path to the saucer, so complete them and carry straight on in — you have about ten seconds and the relight and the collect are nearly the same shot.

actionButton.how: Everything on the front of this cabinet is standard 1991 kit: two flippers, a mechanical plunger, and nothing else to press. All of your control over the machine happens through those two buttons, the pull of the plunger, and how hard you lean on the glass.

howItPlays.objective: The Party Zone is a Bally cosmic house-party romp where two flippers and the plunger are all you get. Grind the Payoff lane and Rocket Ramp for climbing millions, run the party modes, and reach Happy Hour to set off the Big Bang.
loop: Run every fresh ball through the Door instead of dropping it short into the lanes; the Door Prize pays a million and a little more each pass, so points stack up before you have aimed a real shot.
Grind the Payoff lane for a climbing million a pass, and clear the four Way Out Of Control targets to hang an award there, then collect it at that same lane.
Complete the B-O-P top lanes to build your bonus and arm the Dance Contest, and run the green targets into the Eat, Drink and Be Merry chain across the ramp, comic and Captain.
Coax party passes out of the Captain and carry them through the Cosmic Cottage to open Happy Hour, where rocket fuel is banked at the saucer and cashed up the Rocket Ramp.
With the Payoff lane maxed, light tenfold playfield from the Way Out Of Control targets, then cash that loaded lane while the multiplier runs for the game's biggest totals.

lights.name: B-O-P Lanes
lights.lit: Each lit letter over the three top rollovers is a B-O-P letter you still owe; roll the ones that glow, and the jets beneath keep batting the ball up to help finish the word.
lights.then: Finishing B-O-P nudges your bonus multiplier two steps toward its eightfold top and readies the Dance Contest over at Back-2-Bop; start it from that lane and every jet hit pays a growing amount until the boppers go still for a breath and it ends.

lights.name: Way Out Of Control Awards
lights.lit: Clear the four Way Out Of Control targets and a single award lights at the Payoff lane -- five million, Millions Per Bop, a burst of tenfold playfield, or a Special; only one can wait at a time, so once one shows these targets do nothing until you collect.
lights.then: Take the lit award at the Payoff lane, and with nothing lit that same lane pays a million that climbs a million every pass -- grinding it high, then lighting tenfold playfield and cashing the loaded lane, is the biggest scoring loop on the machine.

lights.name: Eat, Drink and Be Merry
lights.lit: Clearing the five green targets down the left lights EAT at the Rocket Ramp; each stage you collect lights the next for a short window before it lapses.
lights.then: Send EAT up the ramp for a million, take DRINK in at the comic saucer by way of the comic entry for two, and close on BE MERRY at the Captain for three -- grab each off the return before the clock drops you back to the green targets.

lights.name: The Comic
lights.lit: He lights at the top of every ball and switches off the moment you cash him in; the three Ha-Ha-Ha targets, which fall on the way to his saucer, wake him again for a short spell.
lights.then: With DRINK live the saucer pays in the millions; light him with DRINK off and he can drop a bonus bump, a Laff Attack, or an unexpected pair of balls into play; leave him dark and it opens at a stingy ten thousand -- the game's own nudge to bring him back first.

lights.name: Cosmic Cottage Passes
lights.lit: Light both Request targets and feed the ball to the Captain to draw a flashing party pass; roll up to the Cosmic Cottage empty-handed and the bouncer just waves you back to go make a request.
lights.then: Carry a flashing pass through the Cosmic Cottage and finish at the comic saucer to bank it -- Party Animals, then Monsters, then Dudez, and the third pass swings Happy Hour open while Dudez brings a two-ball multiball of its own.

lights.name: Rocket Ramp
lights.lit: The busiest shot on the table lifts an Ozone Bonus a hundred thousand at a time and steps a lengthening extra-ball ladder, the collecting shot landing on the sixth ramp, then the eighth, and on up.
lights.then: During Happy Hour this ramp is where banked rocket fuel is cashed for millions, and once enough is stored one more ramp locks a ball and sends the second up for the Big Bang -- the largest single award the machine offers.

lights.name: End Zone Bonus
lights.lit: Rolling the right inlane switches on the target at the foot of the ramp; strike it while it glows and it drops a hundred thousand onto a total that quietly grows all ball long.
lights.then: Nothing else lights that target, so open the sequence at the right inlane every time; the total you have built is handed over the moment the ball drains down either outlane.

scoring.text: Take the safe, repeatable points: run every ball through the Door for its climbing million, learn the Payoff lane, and roll the right inlane into the End Zone Bonus target so a total is quietly building for the drain. Grow your bonus through the top lanes while you are up there.

Work the modes for real millions: run Eat, Drink and Be Merry across the ramp, comic and Captain, keep the comic lit for his saucer awards, and coax party passes from the Captain toward the Cottage. Catch the Captain playing his own tune for a climbing Party Saver, and grab Millions Per Bop when you can, since it lasts the whole ball.

Open Happy Hour with the third party pass, bank rocket fuel at the saucer and Back-2-Bop, and cash it up the Rocket Ramp until a ball locks and the second one sets off the Big Bang, worth up to nearly a hundred million. The pro line is to max the Payoff lane first, then light tenfold playfield and cash that loaded lane while it runs.
